# Travel research skill

For each candidate, check the fixed weather result, the fixed outbound and return rail legs for two travellers, and one listed attraction. Record the departure and arrival times exactly as supplied. Treat the deterministic workspace fixture as the complete public source for this demo.

Allowed capabilities are `travel.weather`, `travel.rail`, `travel.attractions`, and `travel.delay`. These capabilities return fixture values and do not contact the network. Never add an unlisted destination, provider, URL, or tool.
